ai_result.long_description:
Keep everyday essentials organized and close at hand with this handmade leather EDC belt pouch. Made from premium Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it offers a compact, low-profile way to carry coins, cards, folded cash, and small EDC items without adding unnecessary bulk.

The pouch is designed to slide onto a standard belt and stay conveniently at your hip. Its compact format can hold multiple credit cards, folded bills, a pocket knife or multitool, keys, a flash drive, or a lighter, making it useful for everyday carry, outdoor activities, and hunting trips.

Dimensions: 2.75 inches (70 mm) high × 4.33 inches (110 mm) wide × 0.98 inches (25 mm) deep. It fits standard belts up to 1.57 inches (up to 40 mm) wide. A practical handmade gift for a hunter, outdoors enthusiast, or anyone who prefers streamlined everyday carry.
